drafted_from: tool:google-account-list_send_as's own row in tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (invoke method, url, body_template, input and output schema); Gmail response values worked out from that row for the synthetic input
start_here: Say to your AI: "List the addresses I can send from and their signatures. Use my Google account connection service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery." It runs tool:google-account-list_send_as as that account and hands back the Gmail answer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it calls Gmail for one Google account the connection names and answers what Gmail returns.
instructions: 1. Connect a Google account in your Workshop connections and note its handle, like service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery.

2. Say to your AI: "List the addresses I can send from and their signatures." and let it call run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:google-account-list_send_as, and the input {"connection":{"connection_id":"service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery"}}.
3. Read what comes back: the request goes as GET  the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/settings/sendAs.
4. Pick the single row whose isPrimary is true; aliases are outside the signature tools.
